evidence.quote:
requires a signed release
manifest before it ships

observations.why: The gate is framed as a security-and-stability safeguard that must precede every shipment, appealing to conservation.

evidence.quote: that is the whole reason for the gate

observations.why: Past security lapses are cited as the justification for the gate, appealing to conservation of safety and competence in process quality.
The gate rule is restated as a security requirement, the conservation appeal carried by 'required'.
Extending the security gate across all deployment environments reinforces the conservation appeal — no environment is exempt from the safeguard.
Claiming ownership of the gate positions the speaker as the authority behind the process, a mild self-enhancement appeal through standing.
